notes: Exploratory structural filter search. Small sample / multiple testing; no predictive improvement established. Whites remain 1..70 in both Mega Millions eras; Mega Ball changes to 1..24 in 2025. Two overlapping nested special cases (all-five ending-digit and exact ten-step) are separately enumerated for exact filter-union calculations. Exact one-sided exploratory binomial lower-tail p values recomputed via log factorial with stable backward recurrence; Bonferroni-adjusted significance threshold 0.05 / 110. This screening does not establish causal machine bias.
